lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刨出小小的坑。
lines.en: My claws scratch little pits into the dirt.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地走，羽毛乱颤。
lines.en: I hop along, my feathers shivering.

lines.zh: 被附身以后，我还是只会走直线。
lines.en: Even possessed, I still only walk in straight lines.

lines.zh: 翅膀张一半，我就算飞过了。
lines.en: I spread my wings halfway and call that flying.

lines.zh: 我踩过你的靴子，一点也不怕。
lines.en: I walk over your boot without a shred of fear.

lines.zh: 走三步，啄一下地，再走三步。
lines.en: Three steps, a peck at the ground, three more.

lines.zh: 白羽毛上沾着一点灰。
lines.en: A little ash clings to my white feathers.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很碎，声音却很清楚。
lines.en: My steps are tiny, but the sound carries.

lines.zh: 我从鸡舍门口走到你的脚边。
lines.en: I walk from the coop door to your feet.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛比普通的鸡更黑。
lines.en: My eyes are darker than a normal chicken's.

lines.zh: 我跟着影子走，影子跟着你。
lines.en: I follow my shadow, and my shadow follows you.

lines.zh: 每一步都像在数什么。
lines.en: Every step looks like counting something.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听你身后的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen behind you.

lines.zh: 没有虫子，我就啄自己的影子。
lines.en: With no bugs around, I peck at my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我咕咕叫，声音不太对。
lines.en: I cluck, and the sound comes out wrong.

lines.zh: 羽毛下面藏着一股冷气。
lines.en: A cold draft hides beneath my feathers.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，装成一个草堆。
lines.en: I squat down and pretend to be a hay pile.

lines.zh: 鸡也会发呆，尤其被附身之后。
lines.en: Chickens space out too, especially possessed ones.

lines.zh: 我在数谷粒，虽然一粒也没有。
lines.en: I count grain, though there is none.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的尾羽就翘起来。
lines.en: When the wind blows, my tail feathers lift.

lines.zh: 我盯着鸡舍的黑暗角落看。
lines.en: I stare at the dark corner of the coop.

lines.zh: 我的心跳很快，小得像鼓点。
lines.en: My heartbeat is quick and tiny as a drum.

lines.zh: 这具鸡身，本来不属于我。
lines.en: This chicken body was never mine.

lines.zh: 你用脚尖碰我，我不躲。
lines.en: You nudge me with your toe; I do not dodge.

lines.zh: 我的黑眼睛映出你的脸。
lines.en: My black eye mirrors your face.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我眨了眨眼。
lines.en: When you look at me, I blink once.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只不喜欢你靠太近。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you, only of your closeness.

lines.zh: 我的头几乎转了一整圈。
lines.en: My head turns nearly all the way around.

lines.zh: 你在找我的眼睛，它一直没动。
lines.en: You search for my eyes; they have not moved.

lines.zh: 这具小身体里住的不是我。
lines.en: What lives in this small body is not me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的种子。
lines.en: I fix my gaze on the seeds in your hand.

lines.zh: 对视久了，你会觉得冷。
lines.en: Hold my gaze too long and you will feel cold.

lines.zh: 才四点生命，你一下就快打没了。
lines.en: Only four points of life; one hit nearly ends me.

lines.zh: 我抖掉羽毛，往旁边跳。
lines.en: I shake off feathers and hop aside.

lines.zh: 疼，但我先传送再说。
lines.en: It hurts, but I teleport first and think later.

lines.zh: 你打中的是羽毛，不是我。
lines.en: You struck feathers, not me.

lines.zh: 我原地消失了半秒，又出现。
lines.en: I vanish for half a second and reappear.

lines.zh: 这一下要是再重些，我就散了。
lines.en: A little heavier and I would come apart.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着跑开，翅膀乱拍。
lines.en: I shriek and flee, wings flapping wildly.

lines.zh: 血很少，地上只有几根毛。
lines.en: There is little blood, only a few feathers.

lines.zh: 被附身的鸡，也会怕疼。
lines.en: Even a possessed chicken fears pain.

lines.zh: 你追不上会传送的猎物。
lines.en: You cannot catch prey that teleports.

lines.zh: 种子，你手里有种子。
lines.en: Seeds. You have seeds in your hand.

lines.zh: 我跟着那把小麦走。
lines.en: I follow that handful of wheat.

lines.zh: 你撒一把，我就啄一把。
lines.en: Scatter a handful and I will peck it up.

lines.zh: 我啄你的掌心，很轻的。
lines.en: I peck your palm, very gently.

lines.zh: 食物是真的，你的好意不一定。
lines.en: The food is real; your kindness may not be.

lines.zh: 我围着你的脚转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle your feet three times.

lines.zh: 种子落地，我先看它再看你。
lines.en: Seeds fall; I look at them, then at you.

lines.zh: 被附身也改不了贪吃。
lines.en: Possession did not cure my greed for grain.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你掌心的谷粒。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the grain in your palm.

lines.zh: 别捏太紧，我啄不开口袋。
lines.en: Do not hold it tight; I cannot peck open pockets.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我尖叫一声。
lines.en: You step on my tail and I shriek once.

lines.zh: 我撞在你小腿上，弹了回去。
lines.en: I bump your shin and bounce backward.

lines.zh: 羽毛蹭过你的裤脚，留下灰。
lines.en: My feathers brush your trousers and leave ash.

lines.zh: 别踢我，我会记住这一脚。
lines.en: Do not kick me; I will remember that kick.

lines.zh: 我被挤到墙角，翅膀张开了。
lines.en: Pushed into the corner, I spread my wings.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我才敢动。
lines.en: You step half back before I dare move.

lines.zh: 这么小的身体，撞起来也有分量。
lines.en: Small as I am, I still carry weight when I hit.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓住你的鞋面。
lines.en: My claws catch on the top of your shoe.

lines.zh: 相碰的一瞬，你身上有铁味。
lines.en: At the touch, I smell iron on you.

lines.zh: 我不让路，鸡也不常让路。
lines.en: I will not yield the path; chickens rarely do.

lines.zh: 另一只鸡也在看着我。
lines.en: Another chicken is watching me too.

lines.zh: 我们互相啄了啄翅膀。
lines.en: We peck lightly at each other's wings.

lines.zh: 被附身的鸡不下蛋，只守窝。
lines.en: Possessed hens lay no eggs, only guard the nest.

lines.zh: 它叫一声，我应一声。
lines.en: It calls once; I answer once.

lines.zh: 两只鸡并排蹲在横木上。
lines.en: Two chickens squat side by side on the rail.

lines.zh: 我们的头同时歪向一边。
lines.en: Our heads tilt to one side at the same moment.

lines.zh: 它也有那种太黑的眼睛。
lines.en: It has those too-dark eyes as well.

lines.zh: 我们不来电，只一起等天黑。
lines.en: We do not court; we simply wait for dusk together.

lines.zh: 窝里的草被我们踩平了。
lines.en: We have trampled the straw in the nest flat.

lines.zh: 同类靠近时，冷气更重了。
lines.en: When kin come close, the cold grows heavier.

lines.zh: 地上有粒种子，我先看见了。
lines.en: There is a seed on the ground, and I saw it first.

lines.zh: 我叼起面包屑，跑了两步。
lines.en: I pick up a bread crumb and run two steps.

lines.zh: 金粒太硬，我啄不动。
lines.en: The gold nugget is too hard for my beak.

lines.zh: 我捡了一根羽毛，是别人的。
lines.en: I pick up a feather that belongs to someone else.

lines.zh: 你掉的线头，被我叼走了。
lines.en: The thread you dropped has been carried off by me.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏进草堆深处。
lines.en: I hide my findings deep in the hay.

lines.zh: 鸡没有口袋，只能含在嘴里。
lines.en: A chicken has no pockets, only its beak.

lines.zh: 我啄起一块骨片，又吐掉。
lines.en: I peck up a bone shard and spit it out.

lines.zh: 掉落的鸡蛋，我推回窝里。
lines.en: I roll the fallen egg back into the nest.

lines.zh: 小东西也要收好，这是我的习惯。
lines.en: Even small things must be stored; that is my habit.

lines.zh: 我不主动打人，但我记住你了。
lines.en: I do not strike first, but I have noted you.

lines.zh: 你踩了那一下，我改变主意了。
lines.en: That one kick changed my mind.

lines.zh: 四点的生命，也够我啄你一口。
lines.en: Four points of life are still enough to peck you.

lines.zh: 目标很小，是我的个头，不是你。
lines.en: The target is small; it is my size, not yours.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我只跟着你的脚。
lines.en: I do not chase people; I follow your feet.

lines.zh: 你抢了我的种子，这事没完。
lines.en: You took my seeds, and this is not over.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚踝，那里没有护甲。
lines.en: I stare at your ankle, where there is no armor.

lines.zh: 被附身的鸡，也会记仇。
lines.en: A possessed chicken can hold a grudge too.

lines.zh: 你听见咯咯声变调了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear the clucking change pitch?

lines.zh: 我选中你，因为你蹲了下来。
lines.en: I choose you because you crouched down.

lines.zh: 一口只有一点伤害，我会啄很多口。
lines.en: One peck barely hurts, but I will peck many times.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛黑得看不见瞳孔。
lines.en: My eyes are so black no pupil shows.

lines.zh: 这次是我先看你，不是你先看我。
lines.en: This time I looked at you first, not the reverse.

lines.zh: 别把我当成一只普通的鸡。
lines.en: Do not mistake me for an ordinary chicken.

lines.zh: 你踢了我一脚，我记住这双靴。
lines.en: You kicked me. I know those boots.

lines.zh: 你的刀收回去，我就盯上你。
lines.en: You sheathe your blade. Now I watch you.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，贴着地面靠近。
lines.en: I lower my body and creep along the ground.

lines.zh: 一跳，两跳，我离你更近了。
lines.en: One hop, two hops, and I am closer.

lines.zh: 你退，我就跟，鸡不怕人。
lines.en: You retreat; I follow, for chickens fear no one.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚停下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for your feet to stop moving.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，我看起来比实际大。
lines.en: With wings spread, I look bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，那里没有眼睛。
lines.en: I circle behind you, where no eyes are.

lines.zh: 咯咯声越来越急。
lines.en: My clucking grows quicker and quicker.

lines.zh: 我不冲，我只一点点逼近。
lines.en: I do not charge; I close in by inches.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太高，我只能够到脚踝。
lines.en: Your boots are tall; I can only reach the ankle.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刨开了一小块土。
lines.en: My claws scratch a bare patch in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我一停下来，你就该紧张了。
lines.en: When I stop moving, that is when to worry.

lines.zh: 这具小身体里，耐心不少。
lines.en: There is a fair amount of patience in this small body.

lines.zh: 你转身太快，我只看到影子。
lines.en: You turn too fast; I catch only your shadow.

lines.zh: 再近半步，我就啄下去。
lines.en: Half a step closer and I will peck.

lines.zh: 我从草垛里出来，一步一停。
lines.en: I step out of the hay, a pause per step.

lines.zh: 你走快，我就飞一段。
lines.en: Walk faster. I fly a stretch.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子，走在你脚后。
lines.en: I keep to your shadow, at your heels.

lines.zh: 你回头，我装作在啄地。
lines.en: You turn. I pretend to peck the dirt.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖弯了，我就等更低。
lines.en: Your knee bends. I wait for lower.

lines.zh: 我离你半格，喙已经张开。
lines.en: Half a block away, my beak already open.

lines.zh: 我啄在你的脚踝上，留了个红点。
lines.en: I peck your ankle and leave a red mark.

lines.zh: 就一点伤害，你也感觉到了。
lines.en: Only one point of damage, and you felt it.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，啄你的手背。
lines.en: I leap up and peck the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 这一口很轻，但我啄得准。
lines.en: This bite is light, but it lands true.

lines.zh: 你甩腿，我顺势飞开半步。
lines.en: You shake your leg; I flutter half a step away.

lines.zh: 羽毛竖起，我的脖子伸得笔直。
lines.en: Feathers raised, my neck stretches straight out.

lines.zh: 我不停地啄，直到你走开。
lines.en: I keep pecking until you walk away.

lines.zh: 喙很小，疼却是真的。
lines.en: My beak is small, but the pain is real.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我就换个位置。
lines.en: Hit me once and I will change position.

lines.zh: 这一啄，是还你刚才那一脚。
lines.en: This peck repays the kick you gave me.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，但我不打算停。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I do not plan to stop.

lines.zh: 你的护腿缝里，正好露出皮。
lines.en: Your legging seam exposes a strip of skin.

lines.zh: 啄完我就跳开，不给还手机会。
lines.en: After pecking, I hop away before you swing.

lines.zh: 这只鸡的喙，比看上去硬。
lines.en: This chicken's beak is harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 我啄你的手背，指甲边最疼。
lines.en: I peck the back of your hand, by the nail.

lines.zh: 这一下啄在膝盖，力度不大。
lines.en: This one lands on your knee. Not much force.

lines.zh: 你的手指伸过来，正好。
lines.en: Your fingers reach down. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，两爪抓住你的袖。
lines.en: I spring and hook both claws in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我连啄三下，位置都没变。
lines.en: Three pecks, all the same spot.

lines.zh: 喙尖挂了一点红，我甩甩头。
lines.en: A little red on my beak. I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我从鸡舍的草堆里钻出来。
lines.en: I push out of the straw in the coop.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂了，出来的不是小鸡。
lines.en: The shell cracked, and what came out was not a chick.

lines.zh: 天刚亮，我的眼睛就已经黑了。
lines.en: At dawn my eyes were already black.

lines.zh: 有人在我身上按了一只手。
lines.en: Someone pressed a hand upon me.

lines.zh: 我落在院子里，抖了抖羽毛。
lines.en: I land in the yard and ruffle my feathers.

lines.zh: 咯咯两声，鸡群都安静了。
lines.en: Two clucks, and the whole flock goes quiet.

lines.zh: 这股冷气，是从别处带来的。
lines.en: This cold draft came from somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先看见你的靴子。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and saw your boots first.

lines.zh: 窝里其他蛋都凉了。
lines.en: Every other egg in the nest has gone cold.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走出，翅膀半开。
lines.en: I step out of the shadow, wings half open.

lines.zh: 院子里的虫忽然都不叫了。
lines.en: Suddenly no insect in the yard is singing.

lines.zh: 新的身体很小，力气却不小。
lines.en: This new body is small, but not its strength.

lines.zh: 羽毛烧焦了，味道很难闻。
lines.en: My feathers scorch, and the smell is awful.

lines.zh: 我从横木上摔下来，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall off the rail and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我不会游泳。
lines.en: Water closes over my head; I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到墙那边。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear across to the wall.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的翅膀，钉在木桩上。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my wing and pins it to a post.

lines.zh: 药水味让我头晕，羽毛立起。
lines.en: Potion fumes make me dizzy and my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 没有种子，我只能啄土。
lines.en: With no seeds, I can only peck at dirt.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我钻进草堆。
lines.en: The thunder is too loud, so I dive into hay.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，翅膀一点用也没有。
lines.en: I fall, and my wings are utterly useless.
